claims.claim_text: Bullying of LGBT students, refusal of restaurant service to transgender people and eviction risks for same-sex couples are unacceptable and must change.
Democrats would combat LGBT youth homelessness.
Democrats would improve school climates for LGBT youth.
Democrats would ensure LGBT people can access necessary health care.
Democrats would protect LGBT people from violence, including ending the crisis of violence against transgender Americans.
